correctness.rationale: For char odd, Gram smoothness iff three diagonal entries, all three principal 2x2 minors and determinant are nonzero; the latter encode individually separable, pairwise coprime, linearly independent binary quadratic triples. Every coprime ordered pair defines a separable degree-two rational map with deck involution; the split/nonsplit fiber counts yield the displayed T(m) and q(q^2-1)(q^3-4q^2+6q-5) projective triples. The q(q^2-1) rational PGL2 orbit is free, transitive, by similarity of nondegenerate ternary forms and SO3=PGL2 in odd characteristic. Correct scalar quotients give N_q and M_q, with no overlooked singular supports. Exhaustive exact verification produced q=3,5,7,11 ordered triple counts and q=3,5,7 smooth Ciani sextuple counts; q=3 orbit checked by independent equation enumeration. The all-q proof does not depend on extrapolation.

value.rationale: This is a motivated arithmetic mass of geometrically smooth branch data for the standard (2,2) conic-bundle Fano family, restricted to the natural full Ciani diagonal locus. It determines a closed count uniform over all odd finite fields, and an exact free PGL2(q) presentation fiber, distinguishing coordinate-marked objects from abstract moduli. The involution-fiber stratification explains the polynomial rather than reporting isolated finite counts; the q=3 value is acknowledged prior and does not alone motivate the claim.
